title: A room's owner broadcasts live to view-only viewers, who follow the reader and watch the host but send nothing back

tasks.title: Broadcasts, signed tickets and call grants on the server
The relay requires a ticket for a broadcast room and lets a viewer only receive
Broadcasting from the lobby and watching as a viewer

acs.text: WHEN a room's owner posts `POST /api/v1/rooms/:roomId/broadcasts` THE SYSTEM SHALL start a broadcast and answer 201 with its id and link `/social/b/:id`; others SHALL get 403 (member) or 404; a second while one is live SHALL get 409; `POST /api/v1/broadcasts/:id/end` by its host SHALL end it
scenarios: AC-001 only the owner starts and ends a broadcast

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in user asks for a broadcast's ticket THE SYSTEM SHALL answer with a ticket signed with the relay secret naming the broadcast, the user, the role (`host` for its host, `viewer` for anyone else) and an expiry 10 minutes ahead; for an ended or unknown broadcast it SHALL answer 404
WHEN a socket connects to a broadcast relay room (`b_<id>`) THE SYSTEM SHALL require a valid ticket for that room and the token's user, and refuse it with 401 otherwise
scenarios: AC-003 the relay requires a ticket for a broadcast room

acs.text: WHILE a viewer is connected THE SYSTEM SHALL let through only its `join`, `leave`, `hello` and `resync`, make its join `isHost: false, canLead: false`, drop every other message it sends (state, presence, spotlight, raise-hand, mode, end), and send it a participants list that names the host only; the host's join SHALL be `isHost: true`
scenarios: AC-004 a viewer can only receive

acs.text: WHEN a user asks for a broadcast's call token THE SYSTEM SHALL grant its host publishing as a call owner, and a viewer `canPublish: false`, `canPublishData: false`, `canSubscribe: true`, `hidden: true`
scenarios: AC-005 call tokens for host and viewer

acs.text: WHEN the owner presses Broadcast in the lobby THE SYSTEM SHALL start it, show the link with Copy, publish the owner's reader to the broadcast room and offer to join its call; End broadcast SHALL end the session and the call
scenarios: AC-006 the owner broadcasts from the lobby

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in user opens `/social/b/:id` and presses Watch THE SYSTEM SHALL take the reader to the host's text with `ctx=social.watch.<id>`, follow the host (breaking away on local input, with "Back to live"), show the host's audio and video in the floating window with no microphone or camera controls, and the number watching; signed out, it SHALL ask to sign in
WHEN the broadcast ends THE SYSTEM SHALL tell viewers "The broadcast has ended" and stop following and the media
scenarios: AC-008 the end of a broadcast
